newsitem.title: USA: Natwest unit files $1 bln asset-backed shelf.
newsitem.headline: Natwest unit files $1 bln asset-backed shelf.

text.p: Financial Asset Securities Corp, a unit of National Westminster Bank Plc, said Tuesday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 billion asset-backed securities.
The offering will be made through Greenwich Capital Markets Inc, the filing said. Greenwich said it intends to make a secondary market in the senior certificates but has no obligation to do so.
Financial Asset, based in Greenwich, Conn., is an indirect limited purpose finance subsidiary of National Westminster Bank Plc and an affiliate of Greenwich Capital Markets, Inc.
Net proceeds from the sale of the securities will be applied by the company to the purchase of Trust Fund Assets or will be used for general corporate purposes, the filing said.
